title: The product's brand (ADR 0989)
description: Everything a person READS that names or styles the product, in one file. Wire names are not here: they never follow the brand (ADR 0987).

name.description: The product's name as every text says it.

fileStem.description: The stem of package and file names, e.g. <fileStem>-1.2.0-arm64.dmg.

publisher.description: Who publishes the build: installers, copyright lines.

credit.description: The credit to the product a white-label build is made from, e.g. "Powered by Alcifra · Hebel Consulting": shown in the About box, the manual cover, the sign-in page and the external-link landing page (ADR 0995). Null where the product is not white-labelled.

fonts.description: The typefaces, by family name. Their files live in brand/assets/fonts: static faces as <Family>-<Style>.ttf (the desktop and the manual), the web's as <Family>Variable.woff2 and <Family>Variable-Italic.woff2, and the licence as <Family>-LICENSE.txt, which must be the SIL Open Font License or Apache-2.0 (BrandFontTests). <Family> is the family name without spaces.

ui.description: What the clients' screens are set in: the desktop, the web and the server's own pages.

document.description: What a document the product writes is set in: the user manual.

wordmark.description: The brand's wordmark, shown in the chrome (web app bar, sign-in page, desktop title bar and logon, manual cover) while the product carries the brand's own name. SVG files relative to brand/assets, the letters outlined (no <text>), nothing external (BrandWordmarkTests).

icon.description: The brand's app icon: a square SVG relative to brand/assets, drawn edge to edge (the build adds the macOS inset). Null keeps the drawn filing cabinet in the brand's colours. Every icon size is generated from it at build time (ADR 0993).

distribution.description: What a build produces is named and published by (ADR 0994): read by the packaging scripts, the image and chart publishing, and the desktop's update check and demo default. Our own installation's configuration does not read it.

bundleId.description: The macOS bundle identifier of the desktop app.

imageRegistry.description: Where the container images are pushed, e.g. ghcr.io/<owner>.

imageName.description: The application image's name; the sidecars are <imageName>-ocr and <imageName>-postfix.

chartName.description: The Helm chart's name as packaged (scripts/package-chart.sh).

releaseRepository.description: The GitHub repository whose releases carry the desktop packages, which the desktop's update check reads.

demo.description: The public demo the desktop's logon window offers.

imprint.description: Who publishes this edition, as the manual cover and the About box show it (ADR 0995).

lines.description: The publisher's name, then its address, one line each.
